title: Gorgeous N. Nashville Home - New Listing
description:
Gorgeous, recently renovated North Nashville home less than 25 minutes from Broadway. This home benefits from a large deck with an abundance of seating, grill, firepit and backyard that is made for lawn games. This 4 bedroom, 2 bath home is the perfect place for families who wish to stay together, trips with friends, or just a fun weekend away. It offers easy access to SR 386 & I-65. Glenbrook Shopping Center is less than a mile away and offers multiple options for dining and shopping.

The space
Four bedrooms, each with its own TV and jack and jill bathrooms. Main area features a pool table and large TV mounted on the wall. Pull out couch sleeps 2 more. 
Spacious outdoor area with seating that is covered and uncovered. Also seating around the back yard firepit. Corn hole provided as well!

Other things to note
This home is pet friendly to dogs only with a two pet maximum. Please make sure you select your pets at the time of booking as a $150 fee is collected for reservations including animals. We do also follow breed and weight restrictions please reach out to us directly for more information!
